title: Review of c36's condensate food chain (SIDX): replicates on fresh seed 5: predators eat a swath of prey and die out by t~4300, prey refill it by division (61 persistent prey splits, generation 3) vs the predator-free twin (1, generation 1)
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 5 (labkit, 256^2, t=10000) and the matched twin with pred_on=0 on the same seed. With predators: ~240 prey and many small predator droplets form from noise by t=400; predator patches eat outward through the prey lattice (t=900-3500), leaving fuel-rich holes; predators are gone by t~4300 and prey droplets refill the holes, with dumbbell and crescent divisions visible at t=2600-3900 (rerun/sheet.png). labkit prey species: 130 splits, 61 persistent, max generation 3, merge/split 0.33; final 175 prey droplets; predator species: 0 persistent splits, 0 left at the end. Predator-free twin: a frozen emulsion of 223 droplets, 69 splits, 1 persistent, generation 1 (rerun_nopred/sheet.png).

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png t=400-10000: discrete prey droplets at bounded size
observations.D: rerun/sheet.png t=2600-3900 dumbbell and crescent divisions at the edge of the eaten zone; FACTS prey species 61 persistent splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.33
observations.X: rerun vs rerun_nopred (same seed, grid, duration): prey 175 vs 223 at the end, persistent prey splits 61 vs 1, generation 3 vs 1

seeds_run.result: pass: predation epidemic, prey recovery by division (61 persistent, gen 3) vs predator-free twin (1, gen 1); predators extinct by t~4300

verdicts.limitation: One epidemic, then the predators are extinct (t~4300 here), so the interaction is a transient that reshapes the prey population, not a standing ecology; predator droplets never divide persistently, and their gain from prey holds by construction (predator material is made only from prey). Prey division is ad1's fuel-starvation fission switched on by the space and fuel predation frees; the twin also differs by lacking the predator material's mass at t=0. No dt/2 or resolution test by me.
